API.digest: digest(value): full sorted compact UTF8 JSON SHA256, not a file-byte digest
API.parse_json_bytes: parse_json_bytes(raw): strict bounded ordinary UTF8 JSON, duplicate keys and floating/nonfinite scores refused
API.validate_preflight: validate_preflight(receipt, packet, reviewed_submissions, *, expected_packet_sha256, artifact_resolver, recording=None)

bounds.limits_behavior: refuse overflow, never truncate or silently omit declarations

meaningful_test_categories: empty and physically distinct equal-text items
partial null versus explicit absence and retained contradictions
complete uncertainty and source-role coverage remains unresolved
context-required with supplied sufficient context, surrounding definitions, cross-reference strings and symbolic aliases are non-errors
disputed declarations and exact agreement without selection or authentication
multiple rules, repeated qualifiers, shared literal anchors and attachments preserved without normalization
Unicode selected-source versus complete-context half-open coordinates
editorial/undetermined and overlapping contrary declared intervals stay diagnostics
cached/supplied recording replay refuses artifact and body tampering
closed preflight replay refuses status/order/pin/mask/eligibility tampering
parser duplicate/nonfinite/score/UTF8/trailing refusal and bounded diagnostic refusal
detached outputs and missing process evidence never authenticate a reviewer
remaining_validation: Root must run inert tests and obtain a separate static implementation review before qualification.

statement_scope_integration.reason: Requires explicit caller expression/rule/occurrence joins and profile-compatible exact full context; freeform scope strings and modality trigger lists are not that AST. No Boolean scope, modality cue or binder is inferred.

status_scope.consistent_declared_normative: mechanical internal declaration consistency only; not meaning, completeness, identity or eligibility
status_scope.declared_interval_diagnostics: only exact source-selector joins to caller-declared operative/editorial/undetermined intervals; no general semantic prohibition
status_scope.non_normative: explicit non-normative interpretation without promoted authority
status_scope.partial: null answers and original missing-field paths retained
status_scope.unresolved: explicit uncertainty or missing source-role coverage, without symbolic aliases inferred
